title: Consolidate Monorepo Into Single Files
description: Consolidate monorepo source into single files where frameworks allow. Keep required separate entry points (Vite main.ts, package.json subpath exports for puzzle plays, vitest/playwright configs). Merge playground core index+core, renderer boot into index, fold lint.script.ts into script.ts where present. Update imports and package exports. Run tests.
summary: Continued single-file consolidation: flattened repo/lib/js/src and ui/styling/rs/src; merged yak/script.ts into Compose.Grasshopper/script.ts; merged scattered bundle files (ui/styling/js, semios/core, vcs/play, framework presentation json, mit-bestand spec, infinite/cavas/rs theme, kernel 2d/3d compute+booleans+trace, compose py/go, coda reference); left mathematical/graph/manifest/generated as codegen output; added package.json scripts to sequence/imperative/framework core+react; routed 22+ project.json targets through script.ts (new script.ts for repo/lib/go, kernel/2d/js, compose hub/go/py, asset, coda go); fixed kernel_2d_rs geometry_drawing_engine→kernel_2d_engine and repo/lib/js test import paths after flatten. Verified: cargo check ui_styling+kernel_2d_rs, repo-lib 68/73 tests (5 pre-existing micro-commit timeouts).
